description: This file defines a command class `EnableTestLanguagePackCommand` used within the OrangeHRM system to enable or manage test language packs. It extends a base command class and includes logic for creating or deleting test language packs based on user confirmation, with safeguards against running in production mode.

classes.name: EnableTestLanguagePackCommand
classes.description: A console command class for enabling, creating, or deleting test language packs within the OrangeHRM system, with safeguards for production environment.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command string identifier used to invoke this command via console.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the core logic: checks environment mode, creates a test language pack, handles exceptions for duplicate packs, possibly deletes the pack based on user input, and reports success or failure.
